document.name: Company news
document.description: Assess the reported business implications for a named company. This recipe evaluates the article, not future stock prices.

criteria.true: The named company or its operations are directly discussed.
criteria.false: The company is absent or only tangentially mentioned.

impact.instructions: What direction of business impact does the event in `article` suggest for `company`?

materiality.instructions: How material is the event described in `article` to `company`?

input.article: Acme signed a three-year supply agreement with a major cloud provider and raised revenue guidance. Margins will be lower during its factory expansion.
An unnamed chip maker is expected to announce a partnership. No financial terms are available.
Acme signed a three-year supply agreement with a major cloud provider and raised revenue guidance. Margins will be lower during its factory expansion.

prompt.article: Acme signed a three-year supply agreement with a major cloud provider and raised revenue guidance. Margins will be lower during its factory expansion.

document.name: Email intent
document.description: Identify the main purpose of an email and whether the sender expects a timely reply.

intent.instructions: What is the primary purpose of `email`?

criteria.question: Seeking information.
criteria.complaint: Reporting dissatisfaction or requesting a remedy.

reply_requested.instructions: Does `email` ask the recipient to respond?

criteria.true: An explicit or implied request for an answer or confirmation.
A deadline or immediate-action request.

input.email: Can we meet Thursday at 2pm? Please confirm before tomorrow so I can book the room.
Here is our monthly product update. New features are available in your account. No action is needed.
Can we meet Thursday at 2pm? Please confirm before tomorrow so I can book the room.

prompt.email: Can we meet Thursday at 2pm? Please confirm before tomorrow so I can book the room.

document.name: Feedback tags
document.description: Apply multiple useful tags to customer feedback and rate the reported problem.

criteria.true: The user asks for functionality that does not exist.
Unexpected failures or defects.

usability.instructions: Does `feedback` describe difficulty using the product?

criteria.true: Confusing or cumbersome interactions.
Explicit positive appraisal.

severity.instructions: How severe is the problem described in `feedback`?
criteria: No problem or a cosmetic annoyance
Essential functionality blocked without a workaround

input.feedback: The dashboard looks great, but finding reports is confusing. Please add a search box.
Every attempt to export my reports crashes the app. I cannot get the data out at all.
The dashboard looks great, but finding reports is confusing. Please add a search box.

prompt.feedback: The dashboard looks great, but finding reports is confusing. Please add a search box.

legend.0: No problem or a cosmetic annoyance
legend.2: Essential functionality blocked without a workaround

document.name: Audience relevance
document.description: Check whether content fits an audience and whether it is promotional.

relevance.instructions: How relevant is `content` to the interests and needs described in `audience`?

criteria.true: It primarily sells or promotes a product or service.
criteria.false: It primarily informs, teaches or discusses.

document.name: Support triage
document.description: Route a support ticket, identify defects, and assess urgency in one call.

criteria.true: Broken or unexpected product behavior.
criteria.false: A question, feature request, or general account issue.

criteria: Can wait for a future release
